capabilities: sync notes between devices in real time (under a second)
encrypt every edit on the device before it leaves
deploy a personal sync server on a Cloudflare Worker
merge edits made offline when devices reconnect
add devices by scanning a QR code from settings
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Author states it is very new with a single tester and advises keeping a vault backup; docs (setup guide, security, cost, protocol) live on external pages.
motivation: The author wanted notes on laptop and phone synced as they type without handing the notes to anyone, with edits encrypted on-device before leaving.
problem: Obsidian's built-in sync requires trusting a hosted service and paying for it, and users who want real-time sync of private notes on their own infrastructure have no built-in option.

relations.evidence: Ownsync runs on a free Cloudflare Worker in your own account.

requires.name: Cloudflare account (free plan sufficient; Workers Paid $5/mo for more)
Ownsync community plugin on each device

summary: Real-time, end-to-end encrypted vault sync through a Cloudflare Worker you deploy and own.
